architectural_decisions.rationale: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform, increasing the security of the system by reducing the gateways to the outside.
It is only the Api Gateway that is responsible for authorization and SSL with the client.
This framework allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
TypeScript was chosen because it is the default language for NestJS and because, thanks to its static typing, it allows for error detection at compile time.
AWS is a set of cloud computing services that allows the creation of scalable and highly available applications.
As a serverless service, it makes it unnecessary to manage infrastructure when there is an increase in the data set and users.
Kinesis Data Streams was used to transmit playlog and audit trail data to ensure the fastest possible data transmission.
The database is implemented in the RDS service, which is a distributed relational database service from AWS.
